description: Price impact on an Arc token: what buying and selling $10, $100 and $1,000 would really get, each quoted by the Uniswap v4 Quoter on its deepest USDC pool (nothing spent), with the cost or loss against the mid price. A hook that refuses quotes or a failed read is refused before payment. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_impact
